reference_description: The plot illustrates the maximum activation value across different layers for various model properties as "attn_output", "ffn_output", "attn_residual", and "ffn_residual". The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 23 with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Max Activation Value," and also has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400 with tick labels at intervals of 50. "attn_output" is represented by a blue dashed line that remains close to max activation value 0 between layers 0 and 15, fluctuates slightly between layers 15 and 21 before rising sharply to a max activation value near 100 by layer 23. "ffn_output" is represented by a green dash-dotted line that is similar to the blue dashed line for "attn_output" but rising to a peak of 165 between layers 21 and 23. "attn_residual" is represented by an orange dotted line which shows a roughly quadratic rise. Max activation value is 0 at layer 0, about 20 at layer 5, 50 at layer 15, and reaches 250 by layer 23. The solid red line represting "ffn_residual" shows an almost identical pattern to the line fore "attn_residual" but rises to a higher max activation value of 400 between layers 21 and 23.
